title: Test case 5 — Rape at a party, found guilty at trial (a standard sentence offence)
shows: The standard sentence scheme: rape committed after 1 February 2018 has a standard sentence of 10 years — a guidepost, not a starting point — so the proposal must say how the sentence relates to it, and the non-parole period must be at least 60% of a term under 20 years (70% over 20 years) unless that is not in the interests of justice. Rape is a Category 1 offence (imprisonment without a CCO); there is no plea discount and no s 6AAA statement after a trial; the Manual's own problems on these points are shown as cautions with their flags.
